title: Llama 4 Scout and Maverick Public Release
summary: Meta announced Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick on April 5, 2025 and made the two models available for download; Llama 4 Behemoth was described separately as still training.
significance: A dated public-release milestone for Meta's Llama 4 model family, specifically the Scout and Maverick models, while preserving the contemporaneous distinction that Behemoth was not part of this release.

verification.note: Meta's first-party Llama 4 announcement is dated April 5, 2025 and states that Llama 4 Scout and Llama 4 Maverick are available for download. The same announcement distinguishes Llama 4 Behemoth as still training, so this candidate does not treat Behemoth as released on this date. Meta's current Llama developer resources independently list Scout and Maverick as obtainable models. No development geography, ancestry, downstream influence, causality, people attribution, or relationship edges are inferred.
